title: Making Connections: The Evolution of Mobile Connectivity
summary: Vodafone shares the latest Making Connections episode, all about evolution of mobile connectivity.
body_markdown:
Sending a message, making a


call


or streaming a video


are things


we’ve


learnt


to take


for


granted


,


but behind every connection is a complex network working around the clock to keep people and businesses connected.


In the below


Making Connections


documentary, we hear from


the


Vodafone engineers and industry experts behind the networks that power everyday life. They reveal how decades of innovation, global collaboration and emerging technologies are helping networks become faster, more


resilient


and more intelligent, supporting everything from


major live


events


,


such as


concerts


and football


games to


the next generation of AI-powered


experiences


.
